# Two reviews ask for changes. Each fix round resumes the agent session. The third review approves.
exec obee run 7
stdout 'item 7 finished after 2 fix rounds'

exec obee status
stdout '^item-7-r1\tdone$'

grep -count=1 '^plan 0 true a ' calls.log
grep -count=1 '^implement 0 true a ' calls.log
grep -count=1 '^implement 1 false a ' calls.log
grep -count=1 '^implement 2 false a ' calls.log
grep -count=3 '^review ' calls.log
! grep '^implement 3' calls.log

grep 'findings=findings of review 0' briefs/implement-1.txt
grep 'findings=findings of review 1' briefs/implement-2.txt

cmp events.log expected-events.log

-- verdicts --
changes
changes
approve
-- expected-events.log --
claim 7
ready 7
release 7
